items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: And then I also took the bass player from Harry Walker's band.

ctx.x: And then I also took the bass player from Harry Walker's band. His name was Louis Matthews, an old man. I wanted all the guys. Now, this is the information what Paul Lee Barnes gave me, the advice. Years ago, he said, if you ever have a band and you want to play, keep this, your style's going to get some seasoned musicians.
